parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Name of the rotated log file stored within the same directory that {{param|#.Name}} is specified. Which MUST use the uri scheme file {{bibref|RFC8089|The file URI Scheme}}.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: The size of the log file in {{units}}. If the device doesn't know the file size then {{param}} will be 0.

parameters.name: LastChange
parameters.description: Last modification date of the file specified by {{param|Name}}.

object.description: Each table entry represents a Log File. This table of log files is informational only and does not allow the Controller to operate on these files in any way.
